record.paper_title: Polycyclic Codes Associated with Trinomials: Good Codes and Open Questions
record.context_brief: parametric families conjectured to be iso-dual
record.original_question: Over a finite field GF(q), are the following families of polycyclic codes always iso-dual? First, when q is a power of an odd prime, a polycyclic code associated with the trinomial x^(2m) ± 2c x^m + c^2 and generated by g(x) = ±x^m ± c. Second, when q is a power of 2, a polycyclic code associated with the trinomial x^(2m) + a^2 x^(2i) + b^2 and generated by g(x) = x^m + a x^i + b.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 4.5. Over GF(q), • If q is a power of an odd prime, a polycyclic code associated with trinomial x^(2m) ± 2cx^m + c^2 and generated by g(x) = ±x^m ± c is isodual. • If q is a power of 2, a polycyclic code associated with the trinomial x^(2m) + a^2x^(2i) + b^2 and generated by g(x) = x^m + axi + b is isodual.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{F}_q$ denote the finite field with $q$ elements. For a monic polynomial $f(x)\in\mathbb{F}_q[x]$ of degree $n$, the polycyclic code associated with $f(x)$ and generated by a polynomial $g(x)\in\mathbb{F}_q[x]$ with $g(x)\mid f(x)$ is the ideal $\langle g(x)\rangle$ in the quotient ring $\mathbb{F}_q[x]/\langle f(x)\rangle$, identified with a linear code of length $n$ over $\mathbb{F}_q$ via the standard coefficient embedding. A linear code $C$ of length $n$ is called iso-dual if $C$ is equivalent (via a permutation of coordinates) to its Euclidean dual $C^{\perp}$.

Decide whether each of the following two statements is true:

(1) Suppose $q$ is a power of an odd prime, $m$ is a positive integer, and $c\in\mathbb{F}_q^{\times}$. Consider the trinomial $f(x)=x^{2m}\pm 2c\,x^{m}+c^{2}\in\mathbb{F}_q[x]$ and the generator polynomial $g(x)=\pm x^{m}\pm c$ (with any consistent sign choice making $g(x)\mid f(x)$). Is the polycyclic code $\langle g(x)\rangle\subset\mathbb{F}_q[x]/\langle f(x)\rangle$ always iso-dual?

(2) Suppose $q$ is a power of $2$, $m$ and $i$ are positive integers with $0<i<m$, and $a,b\in\mathbb{F}_q$ with $b\ne 0$. Consider the trinomial $f(x)=x^{2m}+a^{2}x^{2i}+b^{2}\in\mathbb{F}_q[x]$ and the generator polynomial $g(x)=x^{m}+a\,x^{i}+b$, which divides $f(x)$ since $f(x)=g(x)^{2}$ in characteristic $2$. Is the polycyclic code $\langle g(x)\rangle\subset\mathbb{F}_q[x]/\langle f(x)\rangle$ always iso-dual?
